text.text_excerpt: The drink prices here are pretty unbelievable for a Bourbon street strip club. They have plenty of specials, but the regular prices don't rake you over the coals like some of the surrounding clubs. Monday's and Tuesdays in particular have great themes and now they have "superhero sundays"(!) where if you wear something superhero-esque, you get in free. The quality of the dancers here vary, but I'll say that there are some girls who are really impressive on the poles. Upstairs in the VIP area there is a trapeze too! If you are a regular, you can get a vip card for a little bit of money, which will pay for itself after a few visits and allow you to skip the lines when there is one. That cou...

Female strip clubs are not usually my thing ---- but i think i have more fun there than any other place on Bourbon Street. The girls are sweet, cute and you can tell they take care of themselves. Other strip clubs on Bourbon are janky STD infested dumps i would not put my big toe in frankly. Libby, Russell K, and Andy are managers who clearly know what they are doing. To pick out one girl as a standout would be hard to do- they're ALL amazing.

I went to Larry Flynt's Barely Legal Club with a group of friends for a bachelorette party. We had a great time here, but honestly I could see a night spent here going either way. Overall, I think the most fun part about my night was the group of people I was with, but regardless, we had a blast! The club is pretty standard, it's nothing amazing, but it was easy to see and approach the main stage, and everything was clean. Most of the dancers were really talented! So, it's a great show. One dancer imparticular, who we ended up talking to a lot throughout the night, was really spectacular. Her routines were honestly amazing.
